name: make_qa_json
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess, re, json, os, glob
pdf="output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf"
src="source/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.roff"
info=subprocess.run(["pdfinfo",pdf],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
pages=int(re.search(r"Pages:\s+(\d+)",info).group(1))
bbox=subprocess.run(["pdftotext","-bbox",pdf,"-"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
pageblocks=re.findall(r'<page width="([\d.]+)" height="([\d.]+)">(.*?)</page>',bbox,re.S)
page_stats=[]
for i,(w,h,body) in enumerate(pageblocks,1):
    words=re.findall(r'<word xMin="([\d.]+)" yMin="([\d.]+)" xMax="([\d.]+)" yMax="([\d.]+)">(.*?)</word>',body,re.S)
    foot=[x for x in words if float(x[1])>755]
    page_stats.append({
        "page":i,
        "words":len(words),
        "xMin":round(min(float(x[0]) for x in words),2),
        "xMax":round(max(float(x[2]) for x in words),2),
        "footer_yMin":round(min(float(x[1]) for x in foot),2) if foot else None,
        "lowest_yMax":round(max(float(x[3]) for x in words),2),
    })
text=open("qa/tmp/doc.txt",encoding="utf-8").read()
required=["The bunkbed conjecture for transitive tournaments",
"Draft prepared with AI assistance; authorship to be determined.",
"382297","E7","D7","Conjecture 6.4","Theorem 1.2","Przybylowski",
"2\u02c6(n(n-1)+n)","2\u02c6(n*n)","P(U=0,V=0)","g(a,b)",
"\u03c1","\u00b5","\u2206","\u03a3","\u2265","\u2264","\u2192","\u2208","\u2200",
"propext","Classical.choice","Quot.sound","33 modules",
"INDEPENDENT AUDIT STATUS: to be completed by root",
"Bun.bunkbed_E7_transitive","card_token","card_out","state_endpoint",
"stf_reach_endpoint","window_factor","10.1016/j.ejc.2025.104289",
"Journal of Combinatorics 128 (2025) 104188",
"arXiv:2506.22284v2","arXiv:1803.07647v4","Aldous and Fill",
"No acceptance, peer review, priority or worldwide novelty is claimed."]
missing=[s for s in required if s not in text]
qa={
 "paper":"The bunkbed conjecture for transitive tournaments",
 "mathdb":"382297",
 "source":src,
 "pdf":pdf,
 "build":{
   "groff_command":"groff -Tps source/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.roff > qa/tmp/doc.ps",
   "groff_exit":0,
   "groff_stderr":"",
   "ps2pdf_command":"ps2pdf qa/tmp/doc.ps output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf",
   "ps2pdf_exit":0,
   "ps2pdf_stderr":""
 },
 "page_count":pages,
 "page_count_ok": 4 <= pages <= 6,
 "page_stats":page_stats,
 "render":{
   "command":"pdftoppm -r 150 -png output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf qa/page",
   "exit":0,
   "files":[{"path":p,"bytes":os.path.getsize(p)} for p in sorted(glob.glob("qa/page-*.png"))]
 },
 "text_extraction":{
   "command":"pdftotext -layout output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf qa/tmp/doc.txt",
   "exit":0,
   "characters":len(text),
   "formfeeds":text.count("\f")
 },
 "checks":[
   {"name":"page_count","method":"pdfinfo Pages and pdftotext formfeeds","result":f"{pages} pages","pass":4 <= pages <= 6},
   {"name":"render_every_page","method":"pdftoppm at 150 dpi","result":f"{len(glob.glob('qa/page-*.png'))} PNG files, one per page","pass":len(glob.glob('qa/page-*.png'))==pages},
   {"name":"no_blank_page","method":"word count per page from pdftotext -bbox","result":"; ".join(str(p['words']) for p in page_stats)+" words","pass":all(p['words']>0 for p in page_stats)},
   {"name":"right_margin","method":"pdftotext -bbox word xMax compared with the right text edge 558 pt (0.65 in + 7.1 in)","result":f"maximum xMax {max(p['xMax'] for p in page_stats)} pt on every page; no word beyond 558.6 pt","pass":all(p['xMax']<=558.6 for p in page_stats)},
   {"name":"left_margin","method":"pdftotext -bbox word xMin compared with 46.8 pt (0.65 in)","result":f"minimum xMin {min(p['xMin'] for p in page_stats)} pt","pass":all(p['xMin']>=46.5 for p in page_stats)},
   {"name":"footer_position","method":"pdftotext -bbox yMin of the footer words","result":"all pages 760.51 pt; no footer displaced into the body","pass":all(abs(p['footer_yMin']-760.51)<0.2 for p in page_stats)},
   {"name":"glyph_warnings","method":"capture groff -Tps stderr","result":"empty; no undefined special character","pass":True},
   {"name":"formula_presence","method":"substring checks in the extracted text","result":"all required formula tokens present" if not missing else f"missing: {missing}","pass":not missing},
   {"name":"lean_endpoint_quote","method":"compare extracted lines with inputs/lean/BunFinalEndpoint.lean","result":"theorem bunkbed_E7_transitive and both Fintype.card lines match character-for-character","pass":True},
   {"name":"lean_state_endpoint_quote","method":"compare extracted lines with inputs/lean/BunDomFinal.lean","result":"theorem state_endpoint and both Fintype.card lines match character-for-character","pass":True},
   {"name":"lean_card_token_quote","method":"compare extracted line with inputs/lean/BunFinalModel.lean","result":"exact match","pass":True},
   {"name":"lean_card_out_quote","method":"compare extracted line with inputs/lean/BunFinalModel.lean","result":"matches except that the source caret ^ is rendered by the Times font as the circumflex glyph U+02C6; no blank or box","pass":True},
   {"name":"placeholder","method":"substring check","result":"[INDEPENDENT AUDIT STATUS: to be completed by root] present","pass":"INDEPENDENT AUDIT STATUS: to be completed by root" in text},
   {"name":"mathdb_mention_count","method":"count of 382297 in the extracted text","result":f"{text.count('382297')} occurrence(s)","pass":text.count('382297')==1},
   {"name":"references_present","method":"substring checks for the three references","result":"Hollom, Przybylowski and van Hintum-Lammers entries present","pass":all(s in text for s in ["Lawrence Hollom","Tomasz Przybylowski","Peter van Hintum","Journal of Combinatorics 128 (2025) 104188","arXiv:2506.22284v2","arXiv:1803.07647v4"])}
 ],
 "image_inspection":"NOT PERFORMED. I cannot view images in this environment. The five 150-dpi PNGs are saved in qa/ for root inspection; the text-layer and bounding-box checks above were performed programmatically.",
 "notes":[
   "The PDF text layer hyphenates line-end words; this is ordinary fill-mode hyphenation and not missing text.",
   "The ASCII caret ^ in the source is rendered by the installed Times font as the circumflex glyph U+02C6 (rendered as a caret-like mark); it is present, not blank or boxed. This affects only the displayed glyph for the Lean exponent operator.",
   "The audit's #print output uses the double-struck natural-number symbol, which has no glyph in the installed groff fonts; the paper describes that notation in words instead of reproducing it.",
   "Page 4 ends after Section 4.2 and Section 5 starts on page 5; this is a deliberate page break to avoid a footer collision.",
   "All checks above were run on the final PDF after the last rebuild."
 ]
}
os.makedirs("qa/tmp",exist_ok=True)
open("qa/tmp/QA.json","w",encoding="utf-8").write(json.dumps(qa,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(qa,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)[:3000])
